implemented: Added a platform-neutral src/shared/ui/graph.ts layout contract with deterministic force, hierarchical and radial positions and bounded dimensions.
Extended the typed GraphView response with layout mode and point coordinates while retaining authoritative link-derived, read-only graph construction.
Added a renderer SVG spatial map with layout control, edge/node styling, safe text labels and the existing keyboard-accessible node list as the interaction alternative.
Documented the graph block as reusable by a future Expo/native host and added focused tests plus static layout markers.
limitations: Reference Obsidian Graph behavior, visual comparison and cross-platform visible interaction remain pending external validation.
The spatial SVG is a read-only visualization; node navigation continues through the keyboard-accessible list and graph state never writes vault files.
